scope: User-approved candidate: keep the 50-block residual stream in FP16 instead of FP32, measured on top of the accepted FA kernel with the identical R124 inputs.
variant_scope: Replaces the module-level _modulate_gate used by all 50 main DiT blocks. The two-layer token refiner keeps its FP32 accumulation because that path lives in a class method, so this is a lower bound on a full FP16-stream rewrite.

timing.verdict: slower than the FA base by about 40 percent

numerics.verdict: numerically indistinguishable from the FA base, i.e. the FP32 residual stream was not buying accuracy here - but it also was not costing speed

conclusion: Reject this candidate on performance grounds: it is slower than the FA base while changing almost nothing numerically. The FP32 residual accumulation is therefore not a speed cost in this graph; the remaining step time is dominated by per-block weight staging, not by residual precision.
